records.name: CriticalStrikeBaseline + CriticalAuthority (exact-actor critical baseline)
semantic_facts: Host supplies one CriticalStrikeBaseline per ActorId (spell chance, weapon chance, multiplier); chances finite >= 0 and retained unclamped, multiplier finite >= 1 (critical.rs:113-143).

CriticalAuthority::try_new sorts by actor and rejects duplicate actors, rejects baselines for actors absent from the roster, and stores a dense actor-indexed CriticalValues array (authority.rs:146-189).

Actors without a baseline read CriticalValues::NONE = (0, 0, x2.0) (authority.rs:16-20, 284-293); an actor with no baseline but bound passive crit modifiers therefore crits with the implicit x2.0 multiplier.
The same dense index also holds passive critical-modifier ranges (chance AND raw-163 damage handles) per actor plus an actor-local target-health capability bit (authority.rs:191-282).
Immutable after construction; not touched by reset_runtime (state.rs:1068-1120).

records.name: critical_chance_channel + ImpactPolicy critical flags (payload channel/eligibility)
semantic_facts: Melee/Ranged defense -> Weapon channel; None/Magic defense -> Spell (non-physical), Weapon (physical only) or HybridMax (both) by payload school (critical_modifier.rs:39-60). Matches Trinity SpellCritChanceDone max(physical, magic) (Unit.cpp:7132-7155).
Eligibility is Eligible for every payload unless the spell carries CannotCrit (payload_policy.rs:33-47); it is NOT conditioned on the impact carrying a damage or healing operation.

Only four operation kinds clear the channel afterwards: Instakill (program.rs:1185-1192), InterruptCast, Dispel, DispelMechanic (program.rs:1194-1196 -> definition.rs:614-626). Stun, silence, pacify, aura application, resource, cooldown-adjustment and other non-amount impacts keep crit eligibility (see CSA-C-01).

records.name: critical-chance runtime aggregation (apply_critical_modifiers)
semantic_facts: Source-holder points (active committed cohorts x effective stacks + passive terms x1) and target-holder points are summed in f64 percentage points, divided by 100, added to the channel baseline, and floored at 0 exactly once (critical_modifier.rs:188-241).
Target holder is queried for damage impacts, or for spell-channel Magic impacts restricted to raw-308 caster-spell terms (202-223).

HybridMax applies spell-channel terms to spell chance and weapon-channel terms to weapon chance, then resolve_critical takes max (125-143, critical/resolution.rs:14-28). A spell-only target term (raw 308) is added before the max, Trinity adds it after (see CSA-C-03).
Exclusive groups: greatest absolute stacked amount, canonical key tie-break, equal opposite-sign tie fails (401-436). Predicate filtering precedes exclusivity (381-399).
Target health snapshot read from committed ActorState health only if the source actor has a raw-183 binding (state/modifiers.rs:409-418).

records.name: resolve_critical (points -> probability)
semantic_facts: Forbidden or chance <= 0 -> probability None (no draw); otherwise Probability(min(chance,1)) - clamp only at the probability boundary (resolution.rs:95-113).
Forbidden eligibility skips modifier evaluation entirely (planning/critical.rs:89-90) so CannotCrit payloads cannot fail on crit arithmetic.

Matches Trinity melee path (Unit.cpp:1216-1231) and SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:7279-7307), incl. periodic via AuraEffect (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5707,5791).

op-15 bonus reads one pre-aggregated passive projection factor per (actor, payload) (state/modifiers.rs:360-395).
